author: blu
body: A glyph is narrower than the advance that follows it, and the last glyph on a run needs only its own width to fit, not the trailing gap. Counting by advance alone lets one glyph overhang the box by the difference.

author: blu
body: An ellipsis costs three glyphs of the run it is shortening, so a box with room for fewer than four cannot show one and any text at the same time.
